description: This file defines an Angular component named AppHeaderComponent, implementing a header section with search and toggle functionality for favorites. It includes event emitters for changes and methods for handling user interactions.

classes.name: AppHeaderComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing header UI with search and toggle features

methods.name: onCriteriaChange
methods.description: Emits current search query and favorites filter status to parent component

methods.name: onSearchInput
methods.description: Updates the search query signal and triggers criteria change emission

methods.name: onFavoritesToggle
methods.description: Updates the favorites filter signal and triggers criteria change emission

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the search query and triggers criteria change emission
